title: (RHEA-2017:1088) apache-commons-jxpath bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated apache-commons-jxpath packages that fix several bugs and add various enhancements are now available.
portal_synopsis: apache-commons-jxpath bug fix and enhancement update
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:
https://access.redhat.com/articles/2974891
portal_description: The apache-commons-jxpath package is a Java-based implementation of XPath 1.0 that, in addition to XML processing, can inspect and modify Java object graphs (the library's explicit purpose) and even mixed Java/XML structures. This package is used by various Red Hat Virtualization utilities.
